items.recommendation: Author editor_layout.kit.vixi with three named slots: scene_tree (fixed-width), viewport (flex), inspector (fixed-width). Split stored as Permyriad ratio.
Spec a panel_splitter widget: drag handle (2px line), edict: resize_panel(panel_id: u8, new_width: Permyriad). Width stored as integer fraction of total.
Author scene_tree_panel.kit.vixi: scrollable list of TreeNodeRow slots, driven by flat node list (bounded array of node_ids). Header with NodeSearch.
TreeNodeRow: [depth*indent] [expand_toggle] [type_icon] [node_name:label] [visibility_eye]. All integer: depth:u8, type:u8, is_visible:bool, is_selected:bool.
Add expand_toggle token: two states (collapsed=►, expanded=▼). State=bool. Tap edict: toggle_expand(node_id: u32). Uses CID_STATUS collapsed, CID_ACCENT expanded.
Add visibility_toggle token: two states (visible=eye-open, hidden=eye-closed). Edict: set_node_visible(node_id: u32, visible: bool). CID_TITLE visible, CID_STATUS hidden.
Define SelectionSet(node_ids: [u32; MAX_SELECTION]) where MAX_SELECTION=64. Modifier key (Shift) toggles membership. Edict: set_selection([u32]).

Context menu: fixed-width popup at (screen_x:i32, screen_y:i32). Fixed edict list: [Duplicate, Delete, Group, Rename, Unparent]. Each entry = labeled row + edict id. Dismiss on outside-click or Escape.
Add 5 atlas regions to the kit icon atlas: icon_root, icon_mesh, icon_empty, icon_light, icon_camera. MaterialId enum. Rendered as 12x12 sprite at CID_STATUS / CID_ACCENT when selected.
inspector_panel.kit.vixi: header with node name + undo/redo buttons; scrollable body with dynamic component sections. Driven by selected_node_id (u32).
collapsible_section: header bar with label (CID_TITLE) + chevron + optional 3-dot menu. Content area hidden when collapsed. State: bool is_expanded per section id (u8).
transform_section: 3x Vec3Input rows labeled 'Position', 'Rotation', 'Scale'. Edicts: update_position, update_rotation, update_scale (node_id: u32, xyz: [i32;3]).
stats_readout: list of [label: CID_STATUS] [value: CID_TITLE] rows. Integer values only (vertex_count: u32, tri_count: u32, material_id: MaterialId).
material_section: ColorPicker (ColourId) + two PbrFloatSliders (roughness, metallic — render leaf). The section widget is integer_sot; PBR sliders stay in the presentation lane.
undo_redo_bar: two buttons [Undo] [Redo] with CID_ACCENT active / CID_STATUS disabled states. Edicts: undo() / redo(). Stack depth displayed as badge (integer).
gizmo_mode_toolbar: 4 toggle buttons (Translate/Rotate/Scale/None). Active button: CID_ACCENT. Inactive: CID_STATUS. Edict: set_gizmo_mode(mode: u8).
gizmo_space_toggle: two-state button [L|W]. Local=0, World=1. CID_ACCENT active. Edict: set_gizmo_space(space: u8).
Define 8-variant axis enum as u8. Active axis highlight color: X->CID_DANGER, Y->CID_MARK, Z->CID_ACCENT, XY/YZ/XZ->combined, all->CID_TITLE, none->CID_STATUS.
